summary: Parts pricing does not update to current price when adding a canned line
reported_issue: When adding a canned line to a work order, the parts pricing did not update to the current sell price; it retained the sale price from when the canned line was originally saved.
expected_after_fix: When a canned line is added, the part's pricing should pull the current sell price from inventory (fixed price if fixed, otherwise the category matrix), not the historical saved price.
steps_i_followed: Opened WO S12-24601 lines, clicked New Line and selected canned line 'New Canned Line 1' (4 parts), Save & Close (POST /api/work-orders/.../lines/create-from-canned-line -> 201)
Read the resulting parts and rates on the Finance invoice
Cross-checked the parts against current pricing: inventory (GET /api/inventory/parts) and catalogue (GET /api/parts-catalogue/catalogue-parts)
Added a second canned line ('Milos testing canned lines', 6 parts) to widen the sample
Attempted a fully controlled reprice-then-readd using stocked fixed-price part N10054-038-038BR
actual_now: Canned-line parts are priced at CURRENT pricing when added, not a stale stored value. The two category-priced canned parts N82E-150BR and 4--FLT3030LCB20 (both category 'HD-Truck Accessories') were both added at $58.93 - the live category-matrix rate (identical because same category), exactly as the expected 'use the matrix per category' rule. The stocked fixed-price part N10054-038-038BR (inventory sell_price $200.00, is_fixed_price=true) shows Rate $200.00 on the WO, matching its current inventory fixed price. No stale/mismatched pricing was observed.
notes: Observed canned-line adds reflect current inventory/matrix pricing (fixed price for fixed parts; category matrix for non-fixed), matching expected_after_fix. Could not complete a fully controlled reprice-then-readd on a single part because: the available canned lines do not contain a stocked, repriceable fixed-price part, and the inventory-update and canned-line-create write endpoints are not exposed to the read-only API user (405/404). Recommend a quick manual confirmation: save a canned line at price X, change the part's inventory price to Y, re-add the canned line and confirm it shows Y.
